description: This file defines the DocumentStore class implementing IDocumentStore, managing document sessions, caching, and commit callbacks within OrchardCore using YesSql.

classes.name: DocumentStore
classes.description: Implements IDocumentStore, manages document sessions, caching, and commit callbacks.

methods.name: GetOrCreateMutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a mutable document of type T, caching it for subsequent calls.

methods.name: GetOrCreateImmutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an immutable document of type T, detaching it from session if found.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates a document, executes cache update callback, and handles commit success/failure.

methods.name: AfterCommitSuccess
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute after a successful commit for type T.

methods.name: AfterCommitFailure
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute after a failed commit for type T.

methods.name: CommitAsync
methods.description: Commits session changes, clears cache, and invokes success or failure callbacks.
